entries.english:
Kunz Kreß von Sachsenflur sells to Margarete von Stetten and the convent at Gnadental properties at Gailenkirchen (field names!), as well as one sixth of the great and small tithe at Gailenkirchen; issued at an unstated place, 8 January 1426 (the eighth day after the anniversary); parchment, seals of Thomas von Rosenberg, Harthart Truchseß, Rüdger Sizel, and Cunz Kreß von Sachsenflur.

Date: 1426.

Extent: 1 charter.
